userRequest: Orders for quantity seven return success and appear in order lookup, but their order.created record is absent from GET /events. Diagnose the real cause and restore the event without duplicating payments, changing stock twice, or special-casing the events endpoint.
publicAcceptanceCriteria: A successful quantity-seven order produces exactly one matching order.created record visible through GET /events.
The order has exactly one approved payment and stock decreases exactly once.
Quantity-one orders and existing failure paths remain unchanged.
The fix corrects event recording rather than synthesizing an event only when it is read.

expectedPublicSurfaces.behavior: Expose the event committed with every successful order.
